note: The case maps of the core libraries, each pinned to its repository path and commit (A4: the ledger reads them at pinned commits). B sets the commit of each input to the commit under review; `node tools/ledger.mjs --mc|--ic <checkout>/<path>@<sha> --write` writes its snapshot to external/<id>-<sha12>.json. A null commit is an input not yet pinned: its packages' cases are MISSING until it is.
